main_text.p: Vandal, Suevi & Burgundi, fuerunt de regno Polonię, à locis, quæ inhabitarunt, appellati, & lingua usi sunt Polonica. Fuerunt autem Germani, & non Sarmatæ neq; Scythæ, Matthias à Michou. Et mox, Lingua Sclavorum amplissima est, & per plurimas diffusa terras, ut sunt Servii, Myfii, Rasci seu Bulgari, Bosnenses, Turco hac tempestate subjugati (& alij,) veluti Dalmatæ, Croatæ, Pannonii, Slavi, Carni, Bohemi, Moravi, Slesitæ, Poloni majores & minores, Mazovitæ, Pomerani, Cassubitæ, Sarbi, Ruteni, Moscovitæ. Hi omnes Sclavi & Vindelici (Vandalici) sunt, perampla regna inhabitantes. Sed & Lituani iam fclavonizant: Nugardi quoque, Plescovienses, Smolnenses & Ohulici

Illyrica lingua di-
cta etiam
SclavonicaSlavonica lingua, quæ hodie corrupto nonnihil vocabulo Sclavonica appellatur, latissimè patet: ut qua Dalmatæ, Bosnenses, Chroati, Istrii, longoq; secundum mare Adriaticum tractu, forum Iulii usque, Carni (quos Veneti Charsos appellant,) item Carniolani, Carinthii ad Dravum fluvium usq;: Stirii vero infra Gretzium, secundum Muieram Danubium tenus, indeque Misii, Servii, Bulgari, aliiq; Constantinopolim usq; habitantes: Bohemi præterea, Lusacii, Silesii, Moravi, vagiq; fluvii in regno Hungariæ accolæ: Poloni item & Rutheli latissimè imperantes,

page.notes: The marginal note in the left margin is printed in italic type and reads "Illyrica lingua dicta etiam Sclavonica"; its line breaks are as shown, and the word "dicta" and "cta" are partly obscured by stains, so the reading of "di-cta" and "Illyrica" is doubtful. The first line of the body block ("Vandal") and several words in the text (e.g. "Polonię", "Rasci seu", "Muieram") are partly obscured by stains or ink bleed; the second paragraph's "Charsos" and "Muieram" are as printed or near. Words such as "Muieram" and "Sclavonica" should be checked against the scan. The word "Sclavonica" in the note appears printed in the form "Sclavonica". The text of the last line of the page ("rantes,") is a fragment continuing onto the next page, and the first paragraph ends on that same page in a column block; no catchword or signature is visible.
